subject: AcreetionOS Update — July 04, 2026
body:
Emacs 31.1 has just been released, bringing a plethora of changes and improvements to this venerable editor, and our community is abuzz with the news, particularly in the context of our Arch-based distribution where such updates are seamlessly integrated through pacman and the Arch repos. This update is a testament to the vibrant ecosystem surrounding AcreetionOS, where community contributions and software updates are continually enhancing the user experience.

Development
The recent refinements to our continuous integration pipeline, including the introduction of per-pipeline staging directories and relative symlinks for the latest.iso file, have significantly improved the reliability of our ISO build process, as detailed on our changelog page at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html. These enhancements demonstrate our commitment to streamlining the release process, ensuring that users have access to the latest updates and security patches, such as those issued for AlmaLinux, in a timely and efficient manner.

Community
Our community remains active, with discussions around the latest security updates and kernel sets, including the 7.1.10 and 6.18.46 stable kernels, which can be easily installed and managed using the tools provided by our distribution, such as the pacman package manager. For those looking to dive deeper into the specifics of our distribution, our documentation at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html and wiki guides at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html offer comprehensive insights and tutorials. Additionally, the flash page at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html provides quick access to the latest news and updates.
